Duplicates the CRM>Contact Persons legacy table, which is properly modeled as its own Business Partner + a BUT050 relationship (see sap_target_schema/legacy_to_sap_mapping.csv). This flat text field on Customers is a denormalization artifact of the source design -- don't map it directly, use the dedicated Contact Persons mapping instead.

BP communication data (e-mail, phone) lives in address-linked tables, not on BUT000 itself -- same 'relationship, not a field' pattern as Employees>Phone_Number/Email into PA0105. Links via the BP's standard ADDRNUMBER, not the billing/shipping ADDRNUMBER series from the address mapping (a customer's own communication data is typically on its central/standard address, a third ADRC row) -- resolve which ADDRNUMBER series this attaches to before load.

No standard flat 'account manager' field on the customer master. Modeled as a BP relationship to an Employee, same pattern as Sales Orders>Sales_Rep_ID (VBPA) and Employees>Manager_ID (HRP1001) -- resolve via HR>Employees to get the target PERNR/BP, and confirm the target system's relationship category for this specific business meaning (it may not be a standard delivered one).

No direct 'active' flag on the customer master -- SAP models inactivity via block/deletion indicators instead, and Is_Active=False needs to resolve to the *correct* one. Confirm intended semantics before mapping: LOEVM (marked for deletion, usually permanent) vs. SPERR (posting block, reversible) are not interchangeable, and this data doesn't say which the legacy system meant.
